==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* He is good friends with [[Saken]].
* He and [[Sheriff]] were the first players born in the 2000s to play in the EU LCS.
* Frequently hovers champions during draft as a tribute for his friends, such as {{ci|Shaco}} for [[Marex (Alexis Girat)|Marex]], {{ci|Aurelion Sol}} for [[Saken]] or {{ci|Vel'koz}} for [[Rhobalas]] 
* After his win of the LEC ([[LEC/2025 Season/Winter Playoffs|LEC 2025 Winter]]) with [[Karmine Corp]], he became the third player alongside [[Yike]] to win the LEC in two different teams, after [[Caps]] and [[Hylissang]]<ref>https://x.com/Sheep_Esports/status/1896368788301631590</ref>
=== Individual Awards ===
* EU 3rd All-Pro Team x1 (Spring 2022)
